items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Now I've heard Louie Nelson... I had to get away from the style of Nelson

ctx.x: So you played mostly with the reading bands, that were you?
Oh yeah, yeah. Up until recently. I had to. Well, no, I'm glad you asked this question. Now I'm supposed to play tonight. Now I've heard Louie Nelson.
